Run from a detached scratch repository with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row_294_bd_opv_pywebpush_stub.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The companion transform control applies the identical valid transform to the import-only test and must ESCAPE.
